title: HMS Blonde orange sphere rises from the ocean
summary: Richard Dolan tells of HMS Blonde orange sphere rises from the ocean, about 1825 at near the Cook Islands, South Pacific, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: near the Cook Islands, South Pacific

tellings.quote: and he writes in his diary at 3:30 a.m. on August uh 12th, 1825. This is 200 years ago. He said the Night Watch reported this orange spherical object rise from the ocean uh at 7°.

plain: Richard Dolan, a researcher who writes histories of UFO reports, tells of a diary kept by Andrew Bloxom aboard HMS Blonde, a British navy ship, near the Cook Islands in the South Pacific. According to the diary as Dolan reads it, at 3:30 in the morning on 12 August 1825 the night watch saw an orange, ball-shaped object rise out of the ocean. Dolan tells it to show that such sightings go back some 200 years.
